import math
Rt=25; Rr=22; N=12; off=5
# wheel polygon vertices
verts=[( (Rr if k%2==0 else Rt)*math.cos(math.radians((k//2)*360/N + (0 if k%2==0 else off))), (Rr if k%2==0 else Rt)*math.sin(math.radians((k//2)*360/N + (0 if k%2==0 else off)))) for k in range(2*N)]
# pawl rect
px0,px1=24.2,28.5; py0,py1=-0.75,0.75
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box
poly0=Polygon(verts)
rect=box(px0,py0,px1,py1)
def overlap_at(rot):
    import math
    c,s=math.cos(math.radians(rot)),math.sin(math.radians(rot))
    vr=[(x*c-y*s, x*s+y*c) for x,y in verts]
    p=Polygon(vr)
    return p.intersection(rect).area
for rot in [-37.3333 + d for d in [0,-5,-10,-15,-20,-25,-30]]:
    print(rot, round(overlap_at(rot),3))
# max over fine sweep
import numpy as np
rots=np.linspace(-67.33,-37.33,121)
areas=[overlap_at(r) for r in rots]
print('max area',max(areas),'at',rots[areas.index(max(areas))])
# also check distance from origin to rect vs radii
